root_idea.summary: The root centers on folding or inserting one thing into another, with extensions to enclosure, compactness, disappearance, and passage.
root_idea.development: From the basic image of folding, the lexicon develops meanings such as something being enclosed or concealed, becoming compact or lean, passing away, and related constructions involving a folded or lined structure.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form طَوَى.
Displayed as the verbal noun طَيٌّ in the Quranic simile of folding the scroll.
Displayed under the Quranic proper/place noun طُوًى.
Displayed under the normalized singular passive participle مَطْوِيٌّ.

senses.definition: To fold, roll up, or fold together.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic passage, the object is the heaven; the action is presented through the image of folding a written scroll.

senses.definition: To efface, bring to an end, or destroy.
senses.usage_conditions: An interpretive Quranic extension of the folding image in the passage about the heaven; it is distinct from the literal image of folding or rolling up.
Used in the Quran in the construction “like the folding of the scroll,” describing the manner of the heavens' folding.

quranic_forms.public_pos_label: Noun · place name or verbal noun

senses.definition: Tuwa, the name of a valley or place.
senses.usage_conditions: Used as the name of the place in which Moses is addressed in the Quranic passages.

senses.definition: Twice or doubly sanctified or called.
senses.usage_conditions: A Quranic interpretation of طُوًى as a verbal noun rather than a place name; the repeated action is explained as twice sanctifying or twice calling.

senses.definition: Folded, rolled up, or folded together.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic expression, the heavens are described as being folded or rolled up.

senses.definition: Destroyed or brought to an end.
senses.usage_conditions: An interpretive Quranic reading of the heavenly folding as destruction or annihilation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make something compact or rounded, as though folded.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or extended use applied to bodies and limbs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To render lean, lank, slender, or light of flesh.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person or body made lean by travel or another cause; the evidence does not impose a narrower object-class restriction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bend or fold the neck.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional description of a gazelle bending its neck before lying down safely.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To turn away in affection, withdraw one's countenance, or forsake someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative construction involving the folding or turning of the flank.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To conceal an affair, story, or secret, keeping it inwardly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with an affair, story, secret, or similar matter as its object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To determine or resolve upon an affair, or persevere in it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An extended idiomatic construction; the source records determination and perseverance as lexical explanations distinct from concealment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To suffer hunger intentionally or go without food by purpose.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive or specially construed use associated with intentionally withholding food.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pass from one matter, interval, or station to another without stopping.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to passing from one story to another, from one fast to the next, or from one stopping place to another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To travel through or traverse regions, country after country.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A travel construction with places or countries as the object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To come to, pass by, or sit among a people or party.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction may denote approaching people, passing them, or sitting at their dwelling place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To contract or shorten a distance, bringing a remote thing near.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative construction with distance or remoteness as its object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause life or something else to pass away, come to an end, or be brought to nought.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of causing a person's life to pass away and, more generally, of causing something to end or be destroyed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To wind spun thread onto a winder.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with spun thread as the object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To case or line a well with stones or baked bricks.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verb is also extended to casing bricks in a building.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a water or milk skin, to become spoiled and disintegrated after being folded while still moist.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The moisture or milk remaining in the folded skin causes alteration, odor, and putrefaction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be hungry.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive use, distinct from the causative or intentional-hunger construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For the destination toward which someone intended to go to become remote.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional expression about a person's intended destination or direction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To fold something with several or many foldings, or to wind or coil it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II expresses the repeated or intensive folding action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become folded with many foldings, wound, or coiled.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used especially of a serpent winding or coiling itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To fold together mutually.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal or collective use said of several agents or things.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become folded, folded up, folded together, or rolled up.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The intransitive or quasi-passive counterpart of folding.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For the belly to become lean or lank.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An extended bodily use attested of animals and similar subjects.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To harbor or conceive rancour, malice, love, or affection in the heart.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The emotional object is represented as being folded inwardly in the heart.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The lines, streaks, creases, or folds of a garment, writing, belly, fat, guts, serpent, or similar thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural and related forms may denote repeated folds or crease-like bands in different materials and bodies.

other_classical_meanings.definition: What is enclosed, included, or contained within the folds of writing; figuratively, what is held inwardly in the heart or consigned to oblivion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from physical folds to concealed contents or inwardly held matters.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A casing or lining of stones or baked bricks, especially the casing of a well.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantive nominal use rather than the ordinary verbal noun of folding.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mode or manner of folding, or of being folded.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form may denote the manner or quality of the folding action rather than one individual fold.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An intended destination, direction, aim, purpose, or object of want.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used for the place toward which one purposes repairing as well as for an intended aim or need.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The final stage, limit, or last interval.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed expression synonymous with the final point or last extent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A water or milk skin, especially one spoiled after being folded while moist.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun may be used generally for the skin and specifically for the deteriorated folded skin.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Hunger.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use related to the state of being hungry.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be lean or lank in the belly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival bodily description of leanness in the belly.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Hungry or having eaten nothing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A bodily adjective describing hunger or an unfed condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bundle of cloths, stuffs, or garments folded together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The name is motivated by the items being folded together.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A well cased with stones or baked bricks.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantive noun; the form is grammatically masculine but may be treated as feminine when understood as a well.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A short portion or interval of the night.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression for coming after a short part of the night.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The heart, mind, or inward disposition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use based on a secret being folded within it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In a disputed expression, a person or occupant: “there is no one in the house.”
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical reading is explicitly reported as uncertain and may involve a textual or transcriptional problem.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A level platform or roof, including a place where dates are laid out to dry.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sources give the roof/platform and date-drying place as related uses of a level surface.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A large rock in sandy or otherwise stoneless ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate geographical or topographical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A herd or group of camels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural expression denotes camels arriving in herds; the singular is طَايَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A gazelle that bends or has bent its neck before lying down safely.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized participial description of the gazelle's posture.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Lean or lank, not large in the sides.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival bodily description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A poem whose fundamental rhyme letter is ط.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical use in the terminology of poetic rhyme.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The folding of a garment or cloth, the place where it is folded, or its inside.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form functions both as a verbal noun and as a noun for the folded or inward part.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A winder or device on which spun thread is wound.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The instrumental noun is distinct from the verbal noun of folding.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In popular usage, a small clasp-knife.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A colloquial use, commonly pronounced مَطْوَى without tanwin.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Made compact or rounded as though folded, or possibly lean, lank, or slender in build.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A classical figurative specialization; the evidence records both compact/rounded and lean/slender interpretations.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A well lined or cased with stones or baked bricks.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive-participial noun used substantively for a lined well.

cautions: طُوًى is presented with both the place-name interpretation and the reported interpretation “twice sanctified or called”; the evidence does not resolve the competing readings.
The Lane references to Quran passages use historical citation notation; no such notation has been converted into an unsupported modern verse location.
The expression طُوَوِيٌّ is retained as a rare, explicitly uncertain lexical report rather than treated as secure ordinary vocabulary.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: The supplied Lane primary source-unit count is 71, and all 71 supplied primary source units are audited in lane_unit_coverage; no additional unit identifier is reconstructed.
The exact lexical status of طُوَوِيٌّ is uncertain because Lane itself suggests a possible transcriptional problem.
